{{Quote|No matter what comes, House Teral will endure.|Alek Teral|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Alek Teral''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of [[House Teral]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he tasked a Republic official with protecting a nearby [[House Teral enclave]] from a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] assault in their holdings at the [[Apalis Coast]].<ref name="TOR" />
